prose: The Verge reports Perplexity launched Teammates, always-on agents that take multiple roles in a workspace, reuse projects, skills and memory from existing Perplexity tools and build on Perplexity Computer for ongoing large-scale work. Like OpenAI's Dots and Claude Duet, each Teammate can run jobs simultaneously, tracked in app threads and Slack. It needs the $200/month Max plan. CEO Aravind Srinivas envisions hundreds of teammates per person over time.
highlights: Always-on multi-role agents built on Perplexity Computer
Competes with OpenAI's Dots and Claude Duet
